name: Maya
label: Long-time Premium, threatens to cancel
who: I have been a Premium subscriber since about 2015 and have been on a family or duo plan [4][24][25]. I rely on the home screen and recommendations every day, so layout changes hit me directly.
value_for_money: Says Premium is worth the price for some [7] and that they have stayed for about a decade [20], but threatens to cancel when the home screen is not reverted [2][9]. Price itself is not the stated issue.
loyalty: Stays for the recommendation algorithm [26] and for Spotify overall [12]. Would cancel if the redesigned home screen stays [2][9], and names Apple Music and Tidal as options [10][16].
pain_points: TikTok-style home screen with huge cards and autoplay
Playlists such as On Repeat are hard to find
Home screen blasts volume when scrolling past the top [22]
likes: Recommendation engine that finds similar artists [26]
The scroll bar and older layout they want back [7]
Premium is worth the price for them [7]
Some like the new design and find it simpler on desktop [28][29]
reasons_to_stay: They still value the recommendation algorithm and the catalog, and say Premium is worth the price [7][26]. A poster in this group says they love the redesign [28], and another says they love Spotify a lot despite the home screen [12].
tone: Heated, profane, and emotional, with all-caps outbursts and quick tangents about the home screen.
